answer: In this PoA design, each identity is verified by a Wesolowski VDF: a continuous chain of sequential modular squarings, where every input depends on the preceding output. Creating clones provides no shortcut; GPUs can run separate chains, but cannot parallelize one chain across devices, so each forged persona incurs the same physical delay. Thus an ocean of aliases, reflected in a mirror or scattered across an orchard, cannot evade the bottleneck.
